On-demand saving is right; I don’t need a copy of every bookmark. The saved copy should be a self-contained page that still opens if the original site disappears, and the read-only view, capture date, original-link, update, and remove actions all feel right. I’m happy keeping ordinary search out of the saved copy’s body text.

Two related cases are still needed:

- If the original address is a PDF, save the PDF itself rather than turning it into a page copy.
- Give me an option to preserve the page through the Internet Archive as well, with a link to that archived version.

Once those are covered, preserving pages will be complete.
